name: Niravel
source:
Niravel (full name is Niravel Votvletta) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and one of main characters.
Niravel is a young snake-faced blue ember-eyed om'verai, 2 chio'tai older than Azaries, with bright belly plates. Niravel has white mane and sharp nose plates, as well as sickle-like horns and a neck bracelet.

Younger Niravel used to have shorter hair, darker scales, as well as more cunning and shorter face.
At first glance, Niravel looks like a lite version of Elveos - but calm and smart. Niravel grew up as Elveos' partner-in-crime, without her own opinions and will. Niravel often panics over difficult situations and jealous to Azaries-Alvezes friendship.

Players get a chance to free Niravel from Elveos' influence - if they chose though. Certain players' choices may lead Niravel to becoming a stronger person, but some may make situation worse.
